description: Tracks product-building and design tool repositories from GitHub signals.

items.description: ShareX is a free and open-source application that enables users to capture or record any area of their screen with a single keystroke. It also supports uploading images, text, and various file types to a wide range of destinations.
Super Productivity is an advanced todo list app with integrated Timeboxing and time tracking capabilities. It also comes with integrations for Jira, GitLab, GitHub and Open Project.
AI conversations that actually remember. Never re-explain your project to your AI again. Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/tyvKNccgqN
AI-powered GitHub stars manager with semantic search, auto-categorization, and release tracking
Free, open-source tiling window manager for Apple Silicon Macs, with Niri-style scrolling containers and Hyprland-style Dwindle BSP.

A minimalist Windows desktop sticky note tool. It puts a few quiet, usable, and unobtrusive sheets of paper on your desktop. Native WPF, with support for to-dos and Markdown.——极简 Windows 桌面便签工具。让桌面上有几张安静、可用、不会打扰人的纸。WPF 原生，支持待办与 Markdown。
An open-source, cross OS, community-driven launcher. A lightweight alternative to Spotlight and Raycast. Made with ❤️ from Viet Nam 🇻🇳

iPad-first, open-source iOS AI Agent with native on-device 3D/CAD editing, iPhone support and Android alpha. On-device Linux, terminal, Python/Node.js, Git and web previews; BYOK AI, Notes, Office, Canvas, voice, Skill Hub and supported local models on iOS. 开源设备端 AI 智能体工作台。
Your tasks, your server. An open-source, local-first task manager you can host yourself. Everything you expect from a commercial task app, without the subscription or the lock-in.

Free, sub-second on-device AI dictation for macOS. Dual engines (Whisper + Parakeet) on Apple Silicon. Optional AI polish on your Mac with EG-1 or S1-mini by Superwhisper, Apple Intelligence (macOS 26), Ollama, or your own OpenAI/Gemini/Claude key. Snippets, custom words, no account, no subscription, audio never leaves your Mac.
The control plane for your AI employees

Karui (軽い) is a offline only aesthetically pleasing, sync supported google tasks alternative to do list app, inspired by system-24 theme and windows mobile design system. It's a 145kb apk that allows you to take notes from status bar and from other apps with support for homescreen widgets! Made with ❤️ and Vue

Your work, already underway. A personal AI assistant for your job: mail, chats and tickets become tasks, the agents you already use (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini) do the work, and nothing goes out until you approve. Open source, runs on your machine.
Keep your Mac awake on your terms. A native macOS menu-bar app with condition-based triggers, closed-display mode, and a headless-Mac toolkit. Built for AI agents, servers, and always-on Macs.
